name: Sher Shah Suri
role: Afghan ruler who defeated Humayun at Chausa
contribution: He defeated Humayun at Chausa in 1539 and shifted the regional balance away from early Mughal gains.
context: His rise from eastern Afghan power networks directly affected Bengal's wider political-military environment.
impact: His victories interrupted Mughal consolidation and reconfigured the power map before later Mughal re-entry.
highlight: Sher Shah's Chausa victory reversed early Mughal momentum in the east.
